Tune in to 9to5Mac Daily for today's top Apple news stories. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or via our dedicated RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and into one simple, elegant system—clear out incomplete tasks and ease your mental load. A straightforward to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools to make organising, tracking, and completing your tasks more satisfying. When you've got everything done.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to get new episodes delivered as soon as they are released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Following a Trump executive order, Apple Maps now displays "Lake America" in place of "Lake Ontario"
  • Changes at the top of Apple continue as Ternus takes over as CEO
  • A look at the compensation packages for new CEO John Ternus and Executive Chairman Tim Cook
  • Read the full memo John Ternus sent to Apple employees on his first day as CEO
